name: Tangential Damping CFG (TCFG, core)
plain: Reshapes the negative prediction so it lies on the main axis shared by the positive and negative. It removes the negative's off-axis part before CFG. No parameters in core.
math:
Per batch item, flat c=x−x̂_c, u=x−x̂_u, A=[u;c] (2×N).
SVD A = UΣVᴴ; v₁ first right singular vector.
u_td = (u·v₁)v₁; x̂_u' = x − u_td; then normal CFG.

providers.author: pamparamm
providers.note: blend multiplier and sigma window, see tcfg-ppm

providers.note: Same rank-one projection of the unconditional; the singular vector comes from the 2×2 Gram matrix's top eigenvector; default space eps (velocity on flow).
